description_en: Queries a list of compute engines that are associated with a DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 该接口用于查询指定DataWorks工作空间的数据开发中绑定的数据源列表
name: ListCalcEngines

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace with which the compute engine is associated
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所属的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the compute engine, which must be exactly matched
parameters.help_zh: 查询的数据源名称，精确匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the compute engine. The value of this parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

ODPS
EMR
BLINK
HOLO
MaxGraph
HYBRIDDB_FOR_POSTGRESQL
ADB_MYSQL
HADOOP_CDH
CLICKHOUSE
parameters.help_zh:
查询的数据源类型。目前范围如下，不区分大小写。
ODPS
EMR
BLINK
HOLO
MaxGraph
HYBRIDDB_FOR_POSTGRESQL
ADB_MYSQL
HADOOP_CDH
CLICKHOUSE
parameters.name: calc_engine_type

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the compute engine is used. Valid values:

DEV
PRD
parameters.help_zh:
数据源所属的环境。
DEV：开发环境
PRD：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的数据量，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码。大于等于1的正整数，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The query results for compute engines that are returned on multiple pages

BindingProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace with which the compute engine is associated
BindingProjectId.description_zh: 数据源所在的工作空间ID

BindingProjectName.description_en: The name of the workspace with which the compute engine is associated
BindingProjectName.description_zh: 数据源关联的工作空间名称

CalcEngineType.description_en: The type of the compute engine

DwRegion.description_en: The region where the DataWorks workspace with which the compute engine is associated resides
DwRegion.description_zh: 数据源关联的DataWorks工作空间所在的地域

EnvType.description_en:
The environment in which the compute engine is used. Valid values:

DEV
PRD
EnvType.description_zh:
数据源所在的环境。
DEV：开发环境。
PRD：生产环境

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the compute engine was created

IsDefault.description_en: Indicates whether the compute engine is the default engine of the current type
IsDefault.description_zh: 是否为当前类型的默认数据源

Name.description_en: The display name of the compute engine

Region.description_en: The region where the compute engine resides

TaskAuthType.description_en:
The identity that is used to access the compute engine. Valid values:

USER: the current user
PROJECT: the workspace executor
SUBACCOUNT: a RAM user
STS_ROLE: the Security Token Service (STS) role
TaskAuthType.description_zh:
数据源的访问身份。
USER：当前用户。
PROJECT：项目执行用户。
SUBACCOUNT：子账号。
STS_ROLE：STS角色

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of compute engine instances

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，取值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
